questions: When a raid on a rich cargo ship and a chance to upgrade your hull both demand your crew’s attention this turn, what pulls you toward one and what cost do you feel in the other?
Faced with a dwindling fuel reserve and a whispered tip about a hidden asteroid mine, what tension rises inside you as you decide which to chase?

Your ship’s AI needs a critical patch, but a famed pirate captain offers you a chance to join his elite squad—what internal weight tilts you toward fixing the ship or gaining prestige, and what cost you feel for the path you ignore?
A stormy nebula threatens navigation, yet a mysterious alien artifact drifts nearby—what draws you toward caution or curiosity, and what empties you whichever you skip?
Your crew is exhausted after a long jump, but an unguarded merchant freighter drifts nearby—what drives you to rest them or press the attack, and what empties you when you choose?

A rare weapon component is up for auction, but your ship’s hull integrity is flagging—what stakes rise in your mind when you weigh buying versus repairing, and what loss haunts you whichever you skip?
A distress beacon blares with scrambled coordinates and no identifiable signature—what instinct spikes first when you hear the static?
A rival pirate’s ledger shows a massive profit but the entries are cryptic symbols—what feeling surfaces as you stare at the numbers?
An ancient alien artifact hums with energy yet its purpose is unknown—what pull draws you toward it or away?
A new trade route appears on your map, but the star charts are incomplete and the path glows oddly—what internal cue tells you to chart it or avoid it?
A crew member hands you a sealed cargo crate with no label—what rush of curiosity or caution surges as you contemplate opening it?
A holographic message loops a phrase you don’t recognize, its tone shifting between threat and invitation—what first tug in your gut decides whether you decode it or ignore it?
When a junior pilot claims the loot split is unfair, what pulls you to argue for your cut or to mediate, and what inner cost does each choice bring?
A rival captain accuses you of stealing their intel—what instinct drives you to confront, deflect, or bargain, and what empties you when you pick a stance?
Your engineer refuses to service a weapon until you share a secret—what feel compels you to comply, bluff, or walk away, and what hollows out your confidence afterward?
A crew member’s loyalty wavers after a close call—what internal compass points you to tighten discipline or offer reassurance, and what gnaws at you whichever path you take?
Two factions demand your support for opposing raids—what tug in your mind leans toward profit or reputation, and what loss you sense if you side with either?
An old ally asks for a favor that risks exposing your recent heist—what pressure pushes you to grant or deny, and what remorse shadows the decision?
During a quiet night docked at a cantina, you spot a newcomer eyeing your ship—what draws you to strike conversation or to keep distance, and what empties you if you stay silent?
When a crew member shares a personal story about their home world, what impulse nudges you to listen deeply or to keep the banter light, and what inner void follows each?
A rival pirate offers a toast to mutual success—what feeling pulls you to raise your glass or to decline, and what cost you sense in either gesture?
You spot a lone trader drifting, their cargo barely protected—what internal voice urges you to escort them or to loot them, and what hollowness follows the act?
A seasoned veteran joins your crew for a single run—what instinct makes you treat them as equal partner or as subordinate, and what empties you if you misjudge?
A stowaway hides in the cargo bay, eyes wide with fear—what tug draws you to mentor them or to eject them, and what lingering weight stays with you either way?
When a crew member’s hands tremble while loading loot, what do you assume about their mood and what feeling rises inside you?
A rival’s ship glides smoothly past a meteor field—what inference do you make about their confidence, and what internal reaction does that spark?
During a briefing, a junior officer avoids eye contact when the profit numbers are read—what suspicion forms in you and what pressure it creates?
A merchant’s smile fades as you approach with a price—what read do you get on their desperation, and what feeling it provokes in you?
A distant fleet broadcasts a calm, steady frequency—what guess do you make about their intentions, and what tug in your gut follows?
Your own ship’s alarms chirp softly while a crew member hums a tune—what story do you tell yourself about their state, and what internal cost does that narrative carry?
If no law, no rival, and infinite fuel existed, what would you spend your days doing aboard your ship, and what longing would that fulfill?
With every bounty erased and all debts settled, what pursuit would you chase across the stars, and what emptiness would it soothe?
Given a chance to map any unknown sector without risk, what horizon would you chase, and what inner voice would cheer you on?
If you could keep any single piece of loot forever, regardless of value, what would it be, and what part of you would it satisfy?
When free from the need to earn, what hobby or craft would you devote yourself to aboard the vessel, and what part of your identity would that nurture?
If you could spend a whole cycle in any role—captain, mechanic, scout, or diplomat—without consequence, which would you choose, and what yearning would it answer?
When a secret auction offers a priceless alien artifact and a covert contract promises a fleet of unguarded freighters, what internal clash drives you toward one and what regret shadows the other?

Faced with the chance to betray a longtime ally for a massive payday or to cement a partnership that could last decades, what tug pulls you toward profit or loyalty, and what loss haunts you whichever you pick?

A sudden solar flare threatens navigation, yet a rival’s flagship is docked for repairs—what pull steers you to exploit the chaos or to safeguard your crew, and what emptiness follows the path you take?

You discover a map to a legendary treasure and an invitation to a pirate summit where you could secure political sway—what inner voice leans toward gold or influence, and what cost lingers after your choice?

A crew member offers you a rare spice in exchange for abandoning a planned raid on a wealthy convoy—what tension tugs between indulgence and ambition, and what hollow feeling remains whichever you accept?

A whisper tells of a hidden wormhole that could shortcut your route home, while a rival’s bounty promises a swift, blood‑rich haul—what instinct draws you to the shortcut or the bounty, and what inner ache follows the decision?
